description: This file defines a React functional component named NavigationBar that renders a top navigation bar with several tabs, some of which are conditionally enabled based on whether a species is selected. The component uses React Router's NavLink for navigation and manages active tab highlighting. It is part of a frontend project for a zoo monitoring dashboard.
